title: Configuration comparison on the same complete collection
scope: One original attempt per configuration and case; browser and offline results remain separate.

provenance.selection: Only manifest.plan.trials IDs; validate one candidate and matching original baseline per case. Read saved grades; no replay or provider calls.

execution.order: Candidate first, then bootstrap for each case.
execution.concurrency: An independent 8-worker Jev study was observed sharing the host during this comparison.
execution.caching: Provider response reuse disabled; prompt caching allowed.

limits: Repeated reviewed cases measure regression, not unseen production accuracy.
Offline selection does not establish live XPath, readiness or plural browser behavior.
One observation per case and arm does not establish repeat-run stability.
Execution changed from serial to bounded parallel partway through the collection; compare latency within execution cohorts.
